tools.name: search_calculators
tools.description: Finds Press Equals calculators for a topic. Use short keywords ("mortgage", "paint", "days between dates", "bmi"); try a synonym if nothing comes back.

tools.name: list_calculators
tools.description: Lists every calculator in a category. Without a category, lists the categories.

tools.name: get_calculator
tools.description: Describes a calculator's inputs: key, label, kind, unit, allowed options, limits and default value.

tools.name: run_calculator
tools.description: Runs a calculator and returns its exact results, the step-by-step working where available, and a url that opens the calculator with these inputs. Inputs left out use the defaults from get_calculator.
